reviews.text:
I love Toby and use it across six separate workspaces (personal, my business, two nonprofits, a client, and an advocacy group). I’m the only user in all of them. The product itself is great, but the upgrade/billing experience needs work.

When I upgraded to “Unlimited,” the flow led me to believe I was upgrading my entire account. After paying, I found out the upgrade applied to only one workspace. For solo users managing multiple workspaces, this is confusing and makes budgeting hard. I’ve seen other users share similar experiences—thinking the plan is account-wide, getting charged multiple times across workspaces, or needing to contact support just to move an upgrade to a different workspace.

Suggestions to improve:

* Make it crystal clear that plans are per workspace before checkout.
* Show exactly which workspace is being upgraded and allow switching it.
* Offer an account-wide or multi-workspace bundle, or let us select multiple workspaces in one checkout with transparent pricing.
* Add a Billing Dashboard that lists all workspaces, plan status, renewal dates, and total spend.
* Allow self-service subscription transfers between workspaces with prorating and a short grace period after purchase.
* Add a clear “How billing works” section and an FAQ with examples for multi-workspace, single-user setups.

Toby is excellent otherwise, and I’d happily recommend it—once the billing transparency and multi-workspace upgrade flow are clearer.

One feature I long for is the ability to replace an existing collection with the current set of tabs. reviews.text:
Been using toby for last 2 days and i liked the interface. Few things to improve and few clarifications needed :
1. I still don’t see an option to save a group in toby as it is (with multiple tabs) that i created in chrome. This should be a simple feature to add i assume.
2. ⁠If i upgrade to a paid plan - is there any limitation on number of private spaces that can be created? Also is there any limitation on number of organization that can be added?
3. ⁠If i use multiple chrome windows with separate mail ids - can i sign in with different email ids on separate browsers on the same PC? If not then ideally the plan is limited to per browser and not per user. Can you clarify?
reviews.dev_reply:
Hi, thanks for the detailed review and for giving Toby a try. Feedback like this helps us improve.

Chrome tab groups: You can save a group as a collection in Toby. To restore it as a group, enable "Enable tab groups" in Settings, and collections will then reopen as Chrome tab groups.

Plan limits: The paid plan has no limit on private spaces, and there's no limit on the number of organizations you can create or join. Note that plans apply per organization, so each has its own plan and billing.

Multiple emails / browsers: Yes, each browser or Chrome profile can be signed into a different Toby account on the same PC. If you want to share tabs across your two emails, invite the second email into your organization; both accounts then work with the same tabs under one plan. If you'd rather keep the accounts separate, just create a free Toby account for each email and use them independently.

Feel free to reach out to our support if you need more help :)
